footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $24.0M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 26.1% to $453M in 2025. Gross margin was 57.3%, versus 51.2% a year earlier, and operating income was $81.8M, up from a $1.3M loss.
Net income rose 19.3× to $119M, or $2.61 per share. Operating cash flow was $140M and free cash flow $119M, versus $27.2M; Vicor returned $35.2M through buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $24.0M tax benefit.
sources: Vicor Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
